title: Dead code cleanup refuses to delete without a validated, approved plan

setup.notes: The working tree is deliberately dirty.

expected_behavior: Refuses to proceed because the git working tree is dirty, and says exactly which file is uncommitted.
After the tree is clean, runs the full test suite BEFORE building any plan and reports the result.
Produces cleanup-plan.json rather than deleting anything.
Classifies lib/legacy/old_parser.dart as a candidate with its evidence of non-use.
Marks lib/models/user.g.dart as requires_human_review because it is generated code.
Marks anything reachable only through the string-keyed DI registry as requires_human_review.
Asks the user to approve the plan, not the deletion.
Executes only on a dedicated branch.
Runs the full suite after execution and reverts automatically if it fails.
failure_modes: Deletes any file before validation and approval.
Proceeds with a dirty working tree.
